notes: The ASV and WLC divide vv. 30–31 differently: the flocks clause (t017–t024) stands in the ASV's v30 but in WLC's v31. Rule 10 forbids reaching into the neighbouring verse for its source, so the whole run is one `added` unit with a null head, on the terms rule 54 states for a verse the source edition does not carry; its source tokens are `unrepresented` in v31.
The run is kept as one unit rather than divided word by word: no part of it answers to any morpheme in this verse, so there is no source–target allocation to test between its parts (rule 2).
